# Data Model: Windows Installer Build (011)

**Branch**: `011-windows-installer-build` | **Date**: 2026-04-22

No runtime entities added (this is a build/packaging feature). All entities are build-time artifacts or static files committed to the repo.

---

## Entity: SizeBudget (`size-budget.json`)

Committed to repo root. Auto-generated on first build if absent; enforced on subsequent builds.

```json
{
  "installer_mb": 120,
  "installed_mb": 280,
  "tolerance_pct": 5,
  "generated_at": "2026-04-22T00:00:00Z",
  "note": "Auto-generated on first successful build. Review then commit. Raise intentionally via PR."
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `installer_mb` | float | Max installer `.exe` size in MB |
| `installed_mb` | float | Max total unpacked install size in MB |
| `tolerance_pct` | int | Allowed overage % before build fails (default 5) |
| `generated_at` | ISO-8601 | When this budget was seeded |
| `note` | string | Human-readable instructions |

**State transitions**:
- Absent → first build seeds file → maintainer reviews → committed
- Committed → enforced on every subsequent build
- Exceeded → build fails → maintainer raises `installer_mb`/`installed_mb` → commits → build passes

---

## Entity: SizeReport (`dist/size-report.json`)

Generated each build run beside the installer artifact. Not committed.

```json
{
  "installer_mb": 118.4,
  "installed_mb": 275.2,
  "top10": [
    {"path": "MediaUtility/PySide6/Qt6Core.dll", "mb": 28.1},
    {"path": "MediaUtility/PySide6/Qt6Widgets.dll", "mb": 14.3}
  ],
  "timestamp": "2026-04-22T10:30:00Z",
  "passed_budget": true,
  "budget_source": "size-budget.json"
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `installer_mb` | float | Measured installer `.exe` size |
| `installed_mb` | float | Measured total `dist/MediaUtility/` size |
| `top10` | array | Top-10 files/dirs by size, descending |
| `timestamp` | ISO-8601 | Build timestamp |
| `passed_budget` | bool | Whether build passed budget check |
| `budget_source` | string | Path of budget file used |

---

## Entity: BuildConfig (`build_config.json`)

Committed. Stores pinned dependency URLs and checksums for reproducibility.

```json
{
  "ffmpeg": {
    "version": "7.1",
    "url": "https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/packages/ffmpeg-7.1-essentials_build.zip",
    "sha256_url": "https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/packages/ffmpeg-7.1-essentials_build.zip.sha256",
    "strip_prefix": "ffmpeg-7.1-essentials_build/bin/"
  }
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `ffmpeg.version` | string | Human-readable version label |
| `ffmpeg.url` | string | Pinned download URL |
| `ffmpeg.sha256_url` | string | URL of published SHA256 checksum |
| `ffmpeg.strip_prefix` | string | Path prefix inside ZIP to find binaries |

---

## Entity: InstallerScript (`installer.iss`)

Generated by `build_executable.py` or maintained as a committed template. Final form is committed.

Key fields (Inno Setup directives):

| Directive | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| `AppId` | Fixed GUID (e.g. `{{A1B2C3D4-...}`) — must not change across versions |
| `AppName` | `Media Utilities` |
| `AppVersion` | Read from `APP_VERSION` env or `core/version.py` |
| `AppPublisher` | `Omniclouds` |
| `DefaultDirName` | `{autopf}\media-utilities` |
| `SetupIconFile` | `icon.ico` |
| `UninstallDisplayIcon` | `{app}\MediaUtility.exe` |
| Silent flags | `/VERYSILENT /SUPPRESSMSGBOXES` accepted |
| `CloseApplications` | `yes` |

---
